notes: Progression backbone. All kit tuning constants in scripts/kits/ are the LEVEL-1 / UNTREE'D BASELINE. This registry defines the multipliers applied on top. Server-authoritative; never client-trusted.

skill_tree.solo_first_rule: ALL nodes affect the player's own kit only. No ally-targeted nodes exist at any tree depth.

balance_invariants.level1_vs_normal: player_power(1.0) == normal enemy_hp(1.0) — fair fight at baseline
balance_invariants.max_vs_mythic: player_power(1.72 * 1.35 = 2.322) >= mythic enemy_hp(2.25) — the climb ends in victory
balance_invariants.harness_enforcement: every faction kit harness must assert both invariants
